newsitem.title: CYPRUS: India's Dodsal in $50mln Oman gas field deal - MEES.
newsitem.headline: India's Dodsal in $50mln Oman gas field deal - MEES.

text.p: Indian firm Dodsal has been awarded a $50 million contract to build a gas gathering system and interfield pipelines for the Oman LNG project, the Middle East Economic Survey reported.
"The contract covers the design, detailed engineering, procurement, installation, testing and commissioning of the system," MEES said.
The company will install 45 km of gas pipelines from the Barik field to Saih Rawl and a 41.5 km condensate line from Saih Rawl to Qarn al-Alam.
Dodsal will also install station facilities, control systems, instrumentation and electrical work.
The work is scheduled to be completed in May 2000.
